'''John Monfredo''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 Kashyyyk Regionals]] on 12 September 1999 with Abyssins, according to Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d49">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-20-kashyyyk-regionals-9-12-99d49/ kashyyyk-regionals-9-12-99], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 20 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-20-kashyyyk-regionals-9-12-99d49/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
